color: rgb(22, 52, 77) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
1. Immutable inputs
Raw Combined / Brightfield / Dead / Nuclei images
Frozen original + nucleated-only masks
Gate: segmentation freeze must be verified

div.style: color: rgb(36, 69, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
2. Base classification - every field
Combined RGB state
Dead-object signal and cell relation
Brightfield + nucleus support
Fuse channels into pre-refinement state
Keep supplemental Dead objects

div.style: color: rgb(36, 69, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
3. Continuous all-time calibration
Complete well/site trajectories
Measure N:C, depletion, red loss, shape, Dead signal
Interpolate empirical live references over
continuous density + 12-hour untreated time anchors
No discrete time bins

div.style: color: rgb(36, 69, 41) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
4. Same refinement logic for all images
Eligible: current live + countable + non-border
No treatment gate - no 72-hour gate
Field collapse: 4/5 signals + site + branch consensus
Object multisignal + dual-view consensus
Temporal-remnant tracking
Matched-partner transfer
Complementary cross-view multisignal rescue

div.style: color: rgb(38, 53, 76) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
5. Final decision and outputs
1 Preserve confirmed Dead
2 Rescue supported live objects
3 Field discordance is diagnostic / rescue veto
4 One-signal branch conflict retains prior live state
5 Multisignal unresolved conflict becomes uncertain
Hard gate: uncertainty <=1% at every audit level
Per-cell states + total / live / dead / uncertain
summaries / bounds / QC / audit / reports
Operational proxies - no manual ground truth
